config.label: Hostname of the SMTP server, e
config.description: Hostname of the SMTP server, e.g. smtp.example.net.

config.label: Port
config.description: Port. Defaults to 587 for starttls, 465 for implicit, 25 for none.

config.label: starttls (default), implicit or none
config.description: starttls (default), implicit or none. STARTTLS is required, never opportunistic.

config.label: Username for SMTP authentication
config.description: Username for SMTP authentication.

config.label: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication
config.description: Password or app-specific password for SMTP authentication.

config.label: The only sender this server will use, e
config.description: The only sender this server will use, e.g. "Name <person@example.net>". There is no from parameter.

config.label: Reply-To header on every message, e
config.description: Reply-To header on every message, e.g. "Team <team@example.net>". Unset means no Reply-To header and replies go to SMTP_FROM. There is no reply_to parameter.

config.label: Set to "true" to register the sending tools
config.description: Set to "true" to register the sending tools. Defaults to false: the server cannot send until it is set.

config.label: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to
config.description: Comma-separated addresses and @domains this server may write to. Required with SMTP_ALLOW_SEND=true; "*" allows any.

config.label: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message
config.description: Maximum distinct recipients across To, Cc and Bcc in one message. Default 10.

config.label: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent
config.description: Sliding hourly cap on messages sent. Default 20.

config.label: Maximum size of the composed message
config.description: Maximum size of the composed message. Default 10485760.

config.label: Maximum size of a single attachment
config.description: Maximum size of a single attachment. Default 5242880.

config.label: Directory attachments are read from
config.description: Directory attachments are read from. Unset means attachments are unavailable.

config.label: Comma-separated content types that may be attached
config.description: Comma-separated content types that may be attached. Defaults to a document and image allowlist.

config.label: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message
config.description: Text appended below the standard signature delimiter of every message.

config.label: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr
config.description: File the audit lines are appended to, in addition to stderr.

config.label: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset
config.description: Comma-separated tool names, a prefix with one trailing *, or "essential" for the curated preset.

config.label: Comma-separated tool names or prefixes to remove, applied after SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS
config.description: Comma-separated tool names or prefixes to remove, applied after SMTP_ALLOW_TOOLS.

config.label: Set to "true" to accept self-signed certificates
config.description: Set to "true" to accept self-signed certificates. Prefer a proper internal CA.
